ronald-acuna-jr.name: Ronald Acuña Jr.
ronald-acuna-jr.status: On 60-Day IL (Rehabbing) — Expected Return Early-to-Mid July 2026

current_injury.details: Suffered a non-displaced fracture of the left fibula during Spring Training. Missed significant time in the 2025 season and into early 2026. On the 60-day injured list while rehabbing. Manager Walt Weiss stated the club is hoping for an early return but the fracture timeline is cautious.

injury_history.details: Non-displaced fracture suffered in Spring Training. On 60-day IL while rehabbing.
Strained while running to first base on a grounder vs. Rockies. Placed on 10-day IL, activated ahead of Marlins series. Managed day-by-day after activation.
Strained the medial collateral ligament in his left knee during a game. Missed time but returned.
Torn meniscus requiring surgery. Faced long-term concerns about his clutch-play dominance returning.
Bone bruise and contusion to the left knee. Missed time but recovered.

ronald-acuna-jr.notes: First injury-shortened season since 2023 (torn ACL). Acuña's return timeline is still uncertain. Community contributors should monitor Braves beat reporters (Journal Sentinel, MLB.com) for Rehab Gate updates. Previous knee issues make this fibula fracture particularly concerning. Pre-injury 2025 slash line was .252/.362/.378 with 47 RBIs on limited ABs.

mookie-betts.name: Mookie Betts

current_injury.type: Stiff lower back + right wrist soreness
current_injury.details: Stiff lower back causing consecutive game misses. Out 3+ games as of July 13, 2026. NOT expected to be placed on IL. Manager Dave Roberts: 'He's feeling a little better.' Earlier July 2026: Right wrist soreness also improved after treatment, expected back the next day. Roberts said the soreness did not come from a specific incident and improved after treatment.

injury_history.details: Stiff lower back causing game misses. Day-to-day status. Not expected on IL. One-hit shutout vs. Yankees earlier in the week showed he was still performing at a high level despite discomfort.
injury_history.return_status: Day-to-Day - Expected within days, recurring issue

injury_history.details: Right wrist soreness before loss to Athletics. Improved after treatment. Dave Roberts: 'Betts' wrist is feeling better after treatment, and the expectation is he'll be back in the lineup tomorrow.' Likely related to prior wrist injury rather than a new acute event.
Lineup removal and DL stint earlier in the season. Dave Roberts gave optimistic update as treatment improved symptoms; Betts returned to the lineup.
Severe illness causing significant weight loss (nearly 20 lbs in two weeks). Added death of stepfather to a difficult stretch.
Broken right wrist during batting practice in a freak spring training accident at Camelback Ranch. Struck by a deflected ball from a pitching machine. Sidelined 6-8 weeks.
Strain caused lineup removal and a stint on the injured list. Dave Roberts gave optimistic update as treatment improved symptoms; Betts returned to the lineup.
Sprained left ankle. Managed with treatment and load management. Not a full absence from lineup.

rehab_timeline.notes: Conservative treatment; no IL expected for back or wrist issues. Monitor for recurring oblique problems.

mookie-betts.return_status: Day-to-Day - Expected within days, recurring issue
mookie-betts.notes: Betts' 2025-2026 has been tumultuous — broken wrist, oblique strain, severe illness, personal loss, and now recurring back/wrist issues. All major injuries have resolved. At the time of reporting, he was on a 7-game hitting streak with a .355 average over his last 15 games. Community should update if recurring back or oblique issues worsen or if any future complications arise from the spring training pitching machine accident.

freddie-freeman.name: Freddie Freeman
freddie-freeman.status: Active & Healthy (Chronic Ankle Managed; Occasional Neck Flare-ups)

current_injury.type: Neck stinger (Aug 2025, resolved) + Chronic right ankle (managed)
current_injury.details: No acute injury currently reported. Managing chronic left ankle with occasional flare-ups. Previous neck stinger from August 2025 has fully resolved. As of August 30, 2025: Was out Wednesday due to a neck stinger that went from his neck into his right shoulder. Returned Friday. Dave Roberts: 'There's still some kind of lingering effects, but nothing compromising.' Left wrist HBP incident also caused concern but resolved.

injury_history.details: Late scratch from lineup vs. Cincinnati Reds. Short-lived, returned quickly. Stinger went from neck into right shoulder.
Sprained left ankle. Managed with treatment and load management. Not a full absence from lineup.
Ongoing neck management reported by Dodgers coaching staff after August stinger.

First sustained during 2024 postseason; played through it for World Series MVP. Re-aggravated during batting practice before Tokyo Dome debut. Scratched from first regular-season game at Tokyo Dome vs. Cubs. Roberts: 'thought was it might be scar tissue that broke up during BP.'
Sprained right ankle late in regular season. Underwent debridement and removal of loose bodies in early December 2024. Played through the injury in the 2024 postseason.

rehab_timeline.notes: No active rehab. Chronic ankle managed with load management and occasional treatment. Neck stinger resolved but may recur with contact.

freddie-freeman.return_status: N/A - Currently active and playing regularly
freddie-freeman.notes: Freeman's chronic ankle issues (both right and left) require ongoing monitoring, especially as a first baseman placing heavy stress on lower extremities. Previous left ankle sprain in June 2025, right ankle debridement in Dec 2024, and neck stinger in Aug 2025 suggest a trend. The 2025 neck stinger was minor but may recur with contact. Freeman's Walk-Off Grand Slam in the 2024 World Series cemented his legend despite injury challenges. Community should track Dodgers beat reporters for any lineup changes.
